knowledge_gaps: Fusion is underspecified: the report alternates between a scalar gate and a feature-dependent gate. It omits gate bias initialization, embedding scaling, padding-aware recency normalization, and whether the added LayerNorm changes baseline behavior even when the gate approaches zero.

Prefix exclusion needs a precise definition for truncated training sequences. Sampling with replacement also produces duplicate competitors, implicitly weighting repeated items in the softmax denominator. The intended objective and any proposal correction are not specified.

The experiment lacks optimizer settings, validation frequency, checkpoint-selection rules, and a measured compute allocation for the baseline and three ablations within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting.

Training margins and 20 simulator users do not establish stale-interest interference or functional compatibility. Fixed diagnostic samples and score-scale controls are needed to compare margins across objectives.

Originality 5 and potential 8 are subjective rather than evidence-backed. Difficulty 5 may underestimate efficient prefix-aware sampling and predictor consistency. Objective-only training remains a necessary simpler alternative.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify the negative-sampling objective before implementation, including duplicate weighting, conditional proposal probabilities, and whether excluding historical positives changes the target distribution.
follow_up_queries.query: In SASRec next-item recommendation trained with cross-entropy over one positive and 32 uniform negatives sampled with replacement, excluding the target and observed-prefix items, how do duplicate negatives and prefix-dependent eligibility affect the objective? Compare uncorrected candidate-set cross-entropy with sampled-softmax proposal correction, including the deterministically included positive and accidental-hit handling.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make the recent-history mechanism reproducible and determine whether its benefit exceeds a simpler recency baseline.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec augmented with z_t = LayerNorm(h_t + sigmoid(W[h_t;r_t]+b) r_t), where r_t is an exponentially weighted mean of the latest five causal item embeddings, what implementations or studies specify padding-aware normalization, embedding scale alignment, gate initialization, and baseline-preserving fusion? What ablations distinguish learned gating from a fixed recent-item residual and from adding LayerNorm alone?

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve selection bias and budget feasibility without using test labels or changing the pinned evaluator.
follow_up_queries.query: For sequential recommendation experiments comparing baseline SASRec, multi-negative loss only, recent-history fusion only, and their combination under a total 43,200 GPU-second budget, what validation-selection practices limit overfitting to fixed sampled HR@10 evaluation with 200 users per category and 99 negatives? Include paired user-level uncertainty estimates, checkpoint-search multiplicity, and compute-aware allocation across four datasets.
